title: SR-71 pilot encourages Sherman to join the Air Force

tellings.quote: Um and of course the SR71 pilot he really encouraged me to go in the Air Force

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant who says he was later hired to communicate with aliens, says that before he enlisted he met a pilot of the SR-71, a very fast American spy plane. He says that pilot strongly encouraged him to join the Air Force, which he tells, as in his book Above Black, as an early step on the path that led to his later claimed work.
